trap.label: ordem dos fatos
trap.wrong: When I arrived, the party ended.
trap.right: When I arrived, the party had ended.
trap.why: Em português o pretérito perfeito basta e a ordem fica implícita. Em inglês, o fato anterior pede Past Perfect, o segundo Past Simple.

mcq.q: The party ___ when I got there.

opts: She called, then I had eaten.
I had eaten, then she called.

mcq.q: Before she left, she ___ the door.

fix.wrong: When I arrived, they already left.
fix.right: When I arrived, they had already left.

fix.wrong: The movie had started when we arrive.
fix.right: The movie had started when we arrived.

rewrite.prompt: Una (1º fato no Past Perfect): “The party ended. I arrived.” (when)
rewrite.answer: The party had ended when I arrived.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com already: “They left when I arrived.” (antes)
rewrite.answer: They had already left when I arrived.
